text: Credential CRD_000105 for Dr. Zachary Bautista was issued in Singapore; his 16 claims are all in Thailand and Turkey. This is the jurisdiction-shopping shape at its weakest: two claim countries, no claims at home, nothing else attached. The honest cross-border roster explains it, and the score reflects that. It is surfaced so that a wider spread or a revocation later cannot hide behind familiarity. Next step: passive — revisit only if this credential appears in a future alert.
